discovery.terminal_log_signature: pip reported an unknown package whose downloaded bytes did not match the SHA-256 advertised by the package index

generic_rule.guard: nonzero bootstrap exit before any completed Pyright summary
generic_rule.name: package-download-hash-mismatch
generic_rule.negative_control: a named requirement with a user-supplied incorrect hash remains an ordinary bootstrap failure
generic_rule.pattern_scope: pip hash-mismatch banner followed by unknown package and Expected/Got SHA-256 values
generic_rule.rationale: an unnamed artifact disagreeing with package-index metadata is transport or cache integrity failure, not evidence about whether the candidate selected compatible dependencies

allowed: Add positive and negative unit coverage in tests/test_evaluator_infrastructure.py.
forbidden: No solver, prompt, candidate, goal verifier, repository boundary, model, seed, schedule ordering, or success criterion may change.
